Friendzy / Classic party games / What Happens Next

How to play What Happens Next

Predict the chaos. Vote on the best answer. One player describes a wild scenario involving a real person in the room. Everyone predicts what that person would actually do. Reveal and vote on the most accurate prediction.

2–10 players~8 minSocial & RevealingSocial & discussion games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. One player picks someone in the group and describes a scenario: 'You wake up and you're the president. What do you do first?'
  2. The subject of the scenario stays quiet while everyone else predicts their answer.
  3. After all predictions, the subject reveals their real answer.
  4. Group votes on whose prediction was most accurate.
  5. Rotate — new subject, new scenario.

Example round

  • 'If you accidentally sent a text to your boss that was meant for your best friend, what would you do?'
  • 'You wake up with the ability to read minds for one day. First thought?'
  • 'You find $5,000 in a bag on the street. Be honest — what actually happens?'

Tips

  • The better you know each other, the funnier the predictions.
  • Pick people whose reactions are unpredictable — they generate the best discussion.
